content_text: I believe the camera was level in that yellow room. Maybe a mistake! I really compose instinctively. On ‘Kundun’ I was aware that Marty wanted the shots to be quite formal, and I have conversations about the overall approach with any director, but, for the most part, the composition is usually arrived at instinctively on the day.
